newsitem.title: FRANCE: French government considers new spending curbs.
newsitem.headline: French government considers new spending curbs.

text.p: The French government is considering whether to freeze some spending plans for this year but no decision has been taken, a senior finance ministry source said on Wednesday.
He said the government was constantly looking at spending to ensure it met its target of limiting the total state deficit to three percent of Gross Domestic Product this year.
"We are looking at it. No decision has been taken," he said.
Financial daily La Tribune said on Wednesday that the government planned to freeze 20 billion francs of spending budgeted for 1997 as a reserve against overspending in other areas.
